selection_requirements: Manufactured finished goods or usable accessories with an explicit winter/cold-weather use. Require exact title evidence, concrete winter-use reason, short Korean Coupang query. Keep electric/battery/skin-contact and certification checks as unresolved flags, not automatic exclusions. No food, medicine, services or raw commodities. No claimed profitability without cost evidence.
